comment: Asta Black Divider: 152 px tall pitch-black crescent, convex side right, jagged white rim on the leading edge, thin light inner edge, black lightning crackling off both sides, black shards trailing left. Origin = middle of the crescent body (centre of thickness at mid-height); the crescent spans origin.y +-76 and x -38..+50 from origin, so radius 56 is a compromise (use a vertical capsule half-height 72, half-width 22 if the game supports it). Flies right.

Asta Black Meteorite: f1 black meteor spike slams down, f2 inverted impact flash, f3-7 black anti-magic dome (about 190 px wide, 80 px tall) with a jagged white rim, black lightning bolts off its surface, rocks and grey dust thrown from its base, white ground shockwave ellipse (about 230 px wide); f8-11 the dome hollows into a white-edged shell that expands and vanishes, black shards scatter. ORIGIN = the ground impact point (base centre of the dome), not the visual middle: place it at the landing point on the floor; hit circle radius 95 at the origin covers the dome (only its upper half is drawn). Strongest frames 3-8.

Yuno wind blade: thin 50 px tall crescent of pale green wind, convex side right, white leading edge and dark green outline, two fading green afterimage arcs and small wind streaks behind it. Flies right; rotate it 90 deg for falling (convex side down). Origin = middle of the blade at mid-height (the blade spans x -11..+3, y -25..+25 around it); radius 18.

Yuno Spirit of Zephyr wind spear: about 210 px long green wind spear (white core, dark green rim), sharp leaf-shaped head, two white wind lines spiralling round the shaft and scrolling back, three pale green air rings sliding back from the head, wind motes at the tail. Flies right. Origin = centre of the spearhead (tip at x 222); radius 14 covers the head; the shaft runs 190 px behind it (y 18..30) if the game wants a longer capsule.

Ichigo Shikai Getsuga Tensho: 163 px tall crescent, convex side right, banded white-hot leading edge -> pale blue -> light blue -> blue back edge that frays into flickering spikes and wavy tapered reiatsu wisps trailing left, blue motes behind. Flies right. Origin = middle of the crescent body at mid-height (body spans x -17..+17, y -81..+81 around it; wisps reach 60 px left); radius 58 is a compromise, a vertical capsule half-height 76, half-width 18 fits better.

Ichigo Bankai Getsuga Jujisho: two black reiatsu crescents crossed at +-42 deg into a 143 px tall X (convex sides to the right), crimson rim that flickers, wavy crimson wisps and red motes trailing left. Flies right. Origin = visual centre of the X (body spans x -52..+46, y -72..+71 around it); radius 58.
